artifact.artifact_source: MemeOS Updates public mirror (APKMemeOS download link)

feature_history.notes: Initial baseline Launcher.java already contains folderwidth, MATCH_PARENT width, mBackgroundView padding reduction, mFakeIcon geometry and Folder onLayout hook. c81ea42 only split Launcher.java into Kotlin files.

old_implementation.width_write_path: mContent.layoutParams.width = MATCH_PARENT in onFinishInflate(after) only; not re-applied in onLayout or resetViewsLayoutParams
old_implementation.padding_write_path: mBackgroundView.setPadding(left/3, top, right/3, bottom) in onFinishInflate(after) only; no original padding cache

width_writers: Launcher.resetViewsLayoutParams sets mContent.getLayoutParams().width to a fixed dimension resource
width_overwrite_after_module: resetViewsLayoutParams (launcher) writes first; 61c8868 after-hook re-applies MATCH_PARENT
onLayout (launcher) does not modify mContent width; 61c8868 before-hook re-applies MATCH_PARENT before super.onLayout
padding_writers: Launcher.resetViewsLayoutParams sets mContent.setPadding(l, t, r, b)
Module sets mBackgroundView.setPadding(left/3, top, right/3, bottom)
padding_overwrite_after_module: resetViewsLayoutParams does not modify mBackgroundView padding; module mBackgroundView padding persists
resetViewsLayoutParams overwrites mContent padding; module does not alter mContent padding
current_lifecycle.visual_spacing_target: mBackgroundView padding is the module target; mContent padding/horizontalSpacing are launcher-managed and not modulated by the module

mFakeIcon.geometry: EXPECTED for non-fold devices; BUG_CANDIDATE for fold-large-screen because module does not subtract mContent left/right padding when positioning mFakeIcon
